title: Issue 2818 bounded worker context and transport cost

canonical_core.requested_outcome: Bound delegated execution to an assignment-derived worker-context projection, record observable transport context cost, and let admitted cost evidence influence the existing best-fit decision without weakening capability or proof constraints.
canonical_core.hard_constraints: Do not add a prompt registry, transcript store, telemetry ledger, scheduler, provider-specific portable fields, peer ranking authority, or parent-conversation inheritance.
canonical_core.agent_may_decide: Choose the smallest versioned projection and contextual evidence shape, exact transport parsing seams, fixtures, and stacked PR boundaries while preserving assignment and target-evidence authority.
canonical_core.escalate_when: The work requires provider secrets, a new persistent owner, weakened capability/proof priority, fabricated token metrics, or cannot produce honest supported-host evidence.
canonical_core.next_action: Apply integration proposal 'issue-2818-worker-context-cost-archive-owner' from admitted target authority.
proof_expectations: Projection fixtures prove no authority widening and no parent/broad-state default context.
Cost fixtures preserve unknown metrics and change best-fit selection only among equally safe and capable candidates.
Supported-host evidence distinguishes semantic bytes from effective transport context and makes no unsupported savings claim.
completion_criteria: Three small stacked PRs jointly satisfy #2818 projection, cost-aware ranking, and real-evidence acceptance criteria.
The assignment remains the sole semantic authority and direct local work gains no delegation ceremony.
Observed transport cost can change selection among equally qualified routes while capability and proof advantages still win.
Current supported-host evidence demonstrates reduced effective context or an honest cost-aware non-delegation decision.

goal: Make canonical assignment authority mechanically produce the minimum worker operating context.
Admit observable context inflation into existing expected-burden ranking.
Deliver the lane as three stacked PRs: projection, ranking, and supported-host proof.
non_goals: Do not create a universal prompt framework, worker-context database, transcript archive, or provider taxonomy.
Do not weaken scope, proof, capability, or worker authority constraints to reduce tokens.
Do not claim token savings from prompt size alone or fabricate unavailable metrics.
Do not absorb the broader #2821 structured-executor research lane.

intent_continuity.larger intended outcome: Delegation reduces total successful-completion cost because bounded workers receive bounded context and route selection accounts for actual transport burden.
intent_continuity.this slice completes the larger intended: This lane completes the economy/context follow-on explicitly left by #2817.

execution_bounds.allowed paths: Assignment packet/prompt projection, configured dispatch receipts, contextual delegation-outcome fields, existing best-fit ranking, focused tests, supported-host evidence, review/release metadata, and this plan.
execution_bounds.max changed files: Prefer fewer than 14 product/test files per PR; keep generated or schema parity with its owning source slice.
execution_bounds.required validation commands: Focused assignment adapter, target-evidence/operating-decision, external evaluation, schema/conformance, and changed-path AW proof.
execution_bounds.ask-before refactor threshold: Ask before replacing assignment lifecycle, target-evidence ranking, transport adapters, or the contextual outcome owner.
execution_bounds.stop before touching: Provider credentials, raw transcripts, central prompt/telemetry stores, unrelated Planning owners, or #2821 research-runtime code.

active_milestone.ready: PR 1 provides bounded semantic projection and PR 2 records provider-neutral cost with capability-first target and transport ranking.
active_milestone.optional_deps: Unavailable supported-host metrics must remain explicit unknowns and may support an honest retain-local decision rather than a savings claim.

immediate_next_action: Request fresh review of the complete three-PR stack and preserve merge order.
invariants: Canonical assignment identity remains the sole task, scope, effect, proof, stop-condition, and worker-authority source.
Prompt/context rendering is a projection and cannot widen assignment authority.
Transport metrics are contextual evidence; missing observations are unknown, never zero.
Capability, safety, and proof eligibility precede contextual cost in best-fit selection.
Direct local work constructs no worker-context or transport-cost artifact.

completion_criteria: PR 1 proves an assignment-derived bounded worker-context projection, exact read-first routes, and no broad inherited context by default.
PR 2 records observable semantic/effective context cost and admits it through existing expected-burden ranking with capability-first counterexamples.
PR 3 checks in the historical inflation fixture, current supported-host evidence, and an honest substantive baseline comparison.
The stack adds no peer semantic/ranking authority, provider-specific portable contract, or direct-local-path tax.
